summary: Reads hand, finger, tool, gesture, tracking-state, and status channels from an Ultraleap/Leap Motion controller.
key_concepts: Reads hand, finger, tool, gesture, and tracking-state channels from a single Ultraleap/Leap Motion controller.
API selection matters: Gemini/Orion V4/V5 are current and stable, while legacy V2 preserves older gesture and tool tracking features.
TouchDesigner must be pointed at the correct tracking library location, especially on Windows where LeapC.dll or Leap.dll folder selection is explicit.
Status and debug channels expose device connection, sequence IDs, counts, and per-object tracking flags for runtime health checks.
Hand, finger, tool, and gesture count parameters limit indexed channel groups; data remains tied to the same tracked object while the sensor sees it.

common_gotchas: Only one Leap Motion device can be connected at a time.
TouchDesigner does not include a Leap/Ultraleap hardware or software license; check project licensing separately.
Install Ultraleap Tracking Software first; Gemini drivers are recommended for current Windows/macOS tracking.
On Windows, Library Folder must point at the correct LeapC.dll or Leap.dll folder for the selected API.
Gemini V5 works in one orientation by default, unlike older V2/V4 APIs that could work in either orientation.
V5 has better tracking stability, while V2 preserves some legacy gesture/tool features.
